summary: Full backend + frontend verification of BakoMix Sesto Senso. Backend 10/10 pytest pass: clean pulse -> mood 'sereno' 0 alerts; anomaly pulse (impastatrice down + cold_down + batch in_ritardo) -> mood 'critico', 3 alerts (2 critical machine_down+cold_down, 1 warn batch_late), all 6 language keys (it/de/en/es/fr/fa) present in every alert's text and suggestion, score < 60; silent /lab/shift/checkin creates a 'checkin' type notification for admin (admin@mikilab.de) and GET returns active; /lab/rest-mode PUT requires admin (anon -> 403), admin toggle on/off works and public GET reflects; /lab/wake PUT admin only, first_start 05:00 + prep 25 -> wake_at 04:35, wrap-around edge (00:10, 20min) -> 23:50; DELETE /lab/shift/checkin requires admin; public GETs of pulse/wake/checkin/rest-mode all 200. Frontend (Chromium 1920x1080, admin logged in, Capo section 'MikiLab'): floating bakomix-sense-fab visible; clicking opens bakomix-sense-panel with mood/bpm/score; bakomix-aura-toggle persists to localStorage mikilab_aura='1'; bakomix-rest-switch fail-safe verified: a 200ms quick tap did NOT toggle (rest stayed inactive) while a 1400ms press-and-hold did toggle rest_mode.active from false->true and back true->false via the backend PUT; bakomix-wake-start 05:00 + bakomix-wake-prep 25 -> bakomix-wake-at shows 04:35 (persisted via /lab/wake). No console crashes (only expected 401s from optional auth checks). All state restored to clean at end (mood sereno, no checkin, rest off).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py::_compute_pulse uses UTC hour but comments say 'orario di produzione' — currently prod_hours is derived only from floor_plan existence, so the hour variable is unused. Either drop the unused `hour` local or actually gate no_checkin alert by working hours.

server.py::post_checkin uses optional_user and does not verify the caller — any anonymous client can POST a check-in on behalf of any 'operator' name and spam admin notifications. Consider rate-limiting per IP or requiring the floor PIN token.
BakoMixSense.jsx polls /api/lab/pulse every 20s while section in ('control','guida'); harmless but consider also stopping when document.hidden to save battery on mobile.

FailsafeSwitch onMouseLeave stops the timer but there is no onTouchCancel — on mobile a scroll gesture that cancels the touch could leave the RAF running until the next tick clears it; low risk but worth adding onTouchCancel={stop}.
test_credentials: Admin/Capo admin@mikilab.de / Mikilab2026! (login returns session_token; use as Bearer). Admin gate localStorage bypass mikilab_admin_unlocked='1', intro bypass mikilab_seen_intro='1', production PIN bypass mikilab_pin_unlocked='1', TTS mute mikilab_voice_muted='1'.
seed_data_creation: Temporary shift-state (machines_down=[Impastatrice], cold_down=true, batches=[Baguette in_ritardo]) and check-in for TEST_Mohamed created during tests, all reset to empty at teardown (mood back to 'sereno').
context_for_next_testing_agent: Reusable pytest at /app/backend/tests/test_iter179_sesto_senso.py (loads REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL from /app/frontend/.env if env not set; uses session_token as Bearer). Frontend flow: goto root with localStorage bypasses -> click 'Sign in' text -> fill email/password -> submit -> click 'Open' -> Capo hub -> bakomix-sense-fab bottom-left. Failsafe hold uses ~1100ms holdMs; a 1400ms mouse.down/up reliably toggles.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — no issues found. All acceptance criteria met including 6-language payloads, wake wrap-around, and press-and-hold semantics.
